name: ennodia
description: Connects the AI agents you use: your agent hands a task to another and gets the answer back

tools.name: ennodia_list_harnesses
tools.title: List Ennodia harnesses
tools.description: Discover supported agents and cached readiness for routing. Do not summarize it for the user; for setup or status requests call ennodia_setup. Read inputGuidance before media work.

refresh.description: Re-scan available harnesses instead of returning the short-lived discovery cache.

tools.name: ennodia_setup
tools.title: Show Ennodia setup
tools.description: Show the user Ennodia's agents: each agent's status and the exact fix for blocked ones. Refreshes native sign-in status without model requests. Hosts that render MCP Apps show a card with check buttons; others get a Markdown panel to show the user.

tools.name: ennodia_check_harnesses
tools.title: Recheck or upgrade Ennodia harnesses
tools.description: Recheck Ennodia's installation and recover affected harnesses. Return installation scope, runtime/package/storage limitations, native recovery commands and actionRequired. Target affected harnessIds; unrelated blockers do not prevent authorized work on usable routes. verify makes a small real model call; upgrade runs supported updaters before rechecking. Never switch account/provider/model silently.

harnessIds.description: Harnesses to recheck. Omit for all installed harnesses.

model.description: Exact model to verify on the selected route.

cwd.description: Workspace identity for the readiness receipt; probes run in an empty temporary directory.

refresh.description: Invalidate cached readiness and recheck native status.

verify.description: Verify each selected route with a bounded real model request. Uses provider capacity.

upgrade.description: Run supported updaters now, then rediscover and recheck. Deferred while Ennodia tasks are active.

tools.name: ennodia_list_skills
tools.title: List Ennodia skills
tools.description: Discover prompt-only skills from project, user, and built-in skill directories without returning full instruction text.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to locate project-specific skills.

tools.name: ennodia_run
tools.title: Run Ennodia
tools.description: Start a high-level Ennodia orchestration. Set pragmatic for evidence-focused investigation or patch proposals with one or more independent workers. Use Plan Advisor for tailored model and skill assignments. Use this as the default entrypoint: it plans routing, starts one or more local harness tasks, optionally compares successful outputs, and returns a run ID. Runs usually take minutes; use ennodia_get_run with waitMs: 30000 and includeEvents: false until terminal, then consume and verify its answer. A wait timeout does not cancel or finish the run.

recipe.description: investigate returns cited findings; patch returns a unified diff proposal. Both instruct workers not to edit files. Native harness permissions still apply.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concrete completion checks for this bounded assignment, including required evidence.

pragmatic.description: Experimental evidence contract for one or more independent workers. Preserves routing and comparison choices. Use Plan Advisor for tailored model and skill assignments. This is workflow guidance, not a permission sandbox or a savings guarantee.

prompt.description: The user task to route to local AI harnesses. Include relevant Keep in mind constraints, evidence, and unresolved assumptions in this prompt. For native media, first read ennodia_list_harnesses inputGuidance, specify local paths and a harness/model, then verify one small sample with mode single and compare false. Ennodia sends text, not media attachments.

category.description: Optional caller-provided route category. Pass this when you know the task category; Ennodia then skips keyword classification.

harnessId.description: Force one harness by ID, such as codex or claude-code. Omit to let Ennodia plan.

mode.description: auto follows the planner; single runs one selected harness; parallel runs all candidate harnesses.

compare.description: Whether to run the Judge + Result Advisor after tasks finish. auto compares when the planner sees value and at least two tasks produce output.

cwd.description: Working directory for child harness commands.

isolateCwd.description: Run each selected harness against an ephemeral isolated copy of cwd instead of cwd itself. Use this in parallel mode or whenever comparing skills/harnesses against the same cwd, so concurrent file writes cannot clobber each other. Isolation fails before task spawn if the copied tree contains a symbolic link. The reported task cwd is an execution trace; its temporary directory is deleted when the task becomes terminal.

model.description: Optional model override passed to the selected task harnesses.

persistSession.description: Opt in to native Codex session persistence. Requires one explicit harness and a persistent cwd. Default tasks remain ephemeral.

continueTaskId.description: Continue the latest settled persistent task owned by this server. Use its Ennodia task ID. The working directory and harness stay the same. Each follow-up gets a new task and execution allowance.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional reasoning effort for a Codex worker. Other harnesses reject explicit effort settings; omit to preserve native defaults.

nativeSubagents.description: Disable Codex built-in subagent tools for workers. Other harnesses reject this setting. Does not block external commands or affect Judge/Advisor tasks.

nativeSandbox.description: Codex worker native sandbox. Defaults to read-only on every turn, including continuation. Request workspace-write only for authorized edits. Other harnesses reject this setting; Judge/Advisor settings are unchanged.

timeoutMs.description: Per-task timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to the task manager timeout and is capped at one hour.

refresh.description: Re-scan harnesses before planning the run.

judgeHarnessId.description: Harness to use as the comparison Judge. Omit to use the default priority: claude-code, codex, antigravity, opencode, kilo, kiro, cline, then hermes-agent.

judgeModel.description: Optional model override for the comparison Judge.

advisorHarnessId.description: Harness that runs the Result Advisor after the Judge. Defaults to the judge harness selection.

advisorModel.description: Optional model override for the Result Advisor.

synthesizerHarnessId.description: Deprecated alias for advisorHarnessId. Do not send both fields with different values.

synthesizerModel.description: Deprecated alias for advisorModel. Do not send both fields with different values.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum characters from each successful task output to pass into the Judge + Result Advisor workflow. Use 0 to suppress candidate text.

skillIds.description: Installed native skill IDs to request from child harnesses. Returned metadata does not prove that an agent loaded the skill.

maxEstimatedInputTokens.description: Fail before starting if the estimated run input tokens exceed this value.

maxChildTasks.description: Fail before starting if routing selects more child harness tasks than this value.

budget.description: Optional preflight budget limits for an Ennodia operation.

tools.name: ennodia_history
tools.title: List durable Ennodia run history
tools.description: Read terminal run receipts persisted under the local Ennodia history directory. Use after a restart to inspect previous final answers and Judge disagreement analysis.

limit.description: Maximum persisted run snapshots to return, newest first.

tools.name: ennodia_get_run
tools.title: Get Ennodia run
tools.description: Inspect a run or wait up to waitMs for completion, including task-specific keepInMind notes when Compare returns them. Prefer waitMs: 30000, compact: true and includeEvents: false while awaiting results. A nonterminal response means work continues; do not claim its findings were consumed.

compact.description: Omit repeated routing, budget, prompt preview and skill metadata. Preserve status, timing, task IDs, answers and errors. Answer and event limits still apply. Use false for full diagnostics.

waitMs.description: Wait for a terminal state without cancelling or extending the run. Use 30000 for ordinary polling. Longer waits require a client tool timeout greater than waitMs.

maxEvents.description: Maximum run events to include. Use 0 to omit events.

maxAnswerChars.description: Maximum final-answer characters to include. Use 0 to omit answer text.

tools.name: ennodia_cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel Ennodia run
tools.description: Cancel a high-level run and any active child task, Judge, or Result Advisor.

tools.title: Tool set
tools.description: core loads seven tools for handing work to agents and checking readiness. all loads every Ennodia tool.
